title: Pinpoint — bowling coach app
problem: Casual bowlers without a coach can't see what's going wrong in their throw, or where to start fixing it.
finding: 71% of surveyed bowlers worried about camera setup, so the app opens with a guided tripod setup and a frame check.
outcome: The first prototype tested as too clean and too game-like for a utility app, so I rebuilt it around a bowling-alley theme with scoresheet frames for error tracking.
